xs.$description: Fine print: metadata, timestamps, tiny map labels.

base.$description: Default body text. The baseline of the hierarchy.

lg.$description: Emphasised body: social-post fulltext, inputs, headings.

xxl.$description: Largest step: screen/article titles and article sub-headings (h2–h5).

xxxl.$description: Above the regular hierarchy: standalone statement headlines (e.g. Support).

contentLineHeight.$description: Line height for readable body copy — article body, social-post fulltext. The article body is the reference; keep other long-form content in sync with it via this token.
